Name: FS - Limbus Company Sinner Outfits
Author: liuassociations
Description:
[size=4]Outfits of the Limbus Sinners for the player character. [u]Requires Fashion Sense[/u].[/size]

exactly what it says on the tin!! this is my first venture into pixelart and my first stardew valley mod as a whole so any tips or feedback are greatly appreciated <3

includes:
[list]
[*]hairstyles for all twelve sinners
[*]a default sinner vest, and more unique shirt variants to specific sinners
[*]coat variants, some unique to specific sinners
[*]shoe override to prevent clipping with long hair (ishmael)
[*]a sectoral heterochromia accessory for hong lu (blinking does NOT work at the moment)
[*]an optional skin tone replacement file that replaces skin tones 21 & 22 to match heathcliff and outis' more accurately
[*]a "preset guide" readme where i list hair colors, skin tones, pant colors and shoe colors to use during character creation to really finalize the look
[/list]

[size=4]known issues:[/size]

[list]
[*]not too happy with how most hair looks from the side
[*]some emotes look a little funky with the hair
[*]gregor's arm is very buggy (lol). will need copious amonths of tweaking which will NOT be soon, sorry
[*]needs more kromer
[/list]

Downloads.Description: strongly recommended as a companion to have heathcliff and outis look more accurate! replaces two vanilla skin tones
